paragraphs.text: In today's headlines, english.wafa.ps reports that the UN warns Israeli attacks have pushed Gaza's health system to the brink of collapse.

paragraphs.text: On work and AI, insurancejournal.com reports Australian companies face AI washing claims after a wave of job cuts and offshoring. The ABC reports Qantas is the latest in a list of companies to outsource jobs to India, and carries a segment titled "AI is coming for Qantas jobs". juneesoutherncross.com.au reports a big-four bank boss defends sending jobs offshore.

sources.title: Australian Companies Face AI Washing Claims After Wave of Job Cuts, Offshoring

Qantas the latest in list of companies to outsource jobs to India
AI is coming for Qantas jobs - ABC listen

paragraphs.text: Phoronix reports SUSE is laying off 10% of its workforce due to AI and automation. jsdev.space and gadgetreview.com each carry pieces saying AI layoffs are backfiring as companies rehire workers, and reddit.com has a post about boomerang employees. Fortune reports Goldman says AI layoffs are leaving a 'long-lasting' scar.

paragraphs.text: The USGS recorded five earthquakes: M6.4, 30 km WSW of Lata, Solomon Islands; M6.4, southeast of Easter Island; M6.5 in the Bonin Islands, Japan region; M6.8, 203 km NW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu; and M7.0, 189 km ENE of Nagqu, China.
